items.heading: Naengmyeon
details: Key ingredients: buckwheat noodles, beef broth, cucumber, egg
Chill a light, tangy beef broth thoroughly.
Cook buckwheat noodles and rinse under cold water.
Top the noodles with sliced cucumber, egg and pear.
Pour the icy broth over the top and serve very cold.

items.heading: Sinseollo
details: Key ingredients: meat, seafood, vegetables, broth
Arrange thin slices of meat, seafood and vegetables in a special hot-pot dish.
Pour a light seasoned broth over the arrangement.
Heat over a central charcoal or heat source at the table.
Simmer gently and serve as the broth infuses with the ingredients.
